name: Concept B (baseline): Sundiver hybrid (chemical Oberth + solar sail)
description: docs/analyses/reference-scenarios.md §3, concept-b-baseline. Starts on the post-Jupiter-assist transfer ellipse (r_a = 5.204 AU, r_p = 10.0 R_sun) at aphelion; the C3 = 95 km²/s² departure and JGA are not modelled. A 6.0 km/s perihelion kick followed by a radial sail (beta = 0.25, sigma_eff = 6.12 g/m², ~330 m²) gives v_inf ≈ 107.56 km/s (3.59e-4 c). The sail remains deployed to infinity.

events.notes: Jettisoned hybrid kick stage at 10.0 R_sun; v_p- 194.46 -> v_p+ 200.46 km/s. Sail deploys afterwards.
Radial radiation pressure reduces solar gravity to mu_sun * (1 - beta) on the outbound leg; no impulsive delta-v.
